scopes.compute: Geometry is nested in episode wall. GPU is sampled whole-device occupancy; RAM is lifetime peak. Independent audit CPU user/system and maximum RSS are measured with Linux os.wait4 for the actual audit command, including its waited-for descendants. Maximum RSS is a high-water maximum, not summed memory. Audit costs are separate from the native eight-hour budget.
scopes.final_test: Three versions share the same 70 unseen requested positions, one attempt each. One continued training seed only.
scopes.monitoring: Frozen direct predictions with checker on 35 separate positions; zero-new-request point is unchanged seed22, not further learning.
scopes.publication: New allowlisted derivative, not a replacement for original signed native/audit evidence. No raw rows, coordinates, host configuration or media exported.
scopes.training: Exploratory requests at the same 35 familiar TRAIN positions; rejects retained.
